description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_StringHash, which extends ArrayObject to track access to its keys by overriding offsetGet and providing methods to retrieve and reset accessed keys.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHash
classes.description: A class that extends ArrayObject to keep track of which keys have been accessed, providing additional methods to retrieve and reset access logs.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Overrides ArrayObject's offsetGet to log access to a key and then retrieve its value.

methods.name: getAccessed
methods.description: Returns an array of all keys that have been accessed since the last reset.

methods.name: resetAccessed
methods.description: Resets the access log, clearing the record of accessed keys.

search-terms: PHP class for array access logging
